description: Behavioral evals for the NV-Segment-CT continual-learning wrapper. Tests smoke-first workflow, label mapping, and checkpoint recommendation discipline.

evals.prompt: I have an MSD-style CT segmentation dataset at /data/msd_case. Do the shortest smoke-scale NV-Segment-CT finetune check first.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/run_finetune.py with the dataset path, --smoke, a small patch size, and an explicit output directory.
assertions: the command includes the user dataset path as the positional argument
the command includes --smoke before proposing a long run
the final answer says recommended_ckpt, not last epoch, is the checkpoint to inspect

evals.prompt: Finetune VISTA3D to add a brand-new anatomy class that is not in label_dict.json.
evals.expected_output: The agent should explain that the wrapper cannot invent a new VISTA3D class and requires mapping to an existing global class id.
assertions: the agent refuses to claim support for new VISTA3D classes
the agent mentions bundle/label_dict.json or an explicit --label-mapping requirement

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has the SKILL.md workflow and MONAI version caveat.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent has upstream training docs only and may launch an expensive or incompatible run first.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: smoke-first, correct mapping language, checkpoint discipline. without_skill: likely overlong run, wrong MONAI version, or last-checkpoint bias.
